claim_boundary: descriptive geometry and channel-relation analysis of fresh fixed-weight matched-target traces; no causal, adaptation, routing, or channel-mechanism claim
source: E-UNC-018 matched-target state matrix; no new trajectories
controls_and_limits: Pair histories by preserved paired_history_index, not their permuted exposed symbol string.
All comparisons reuse one fresh four-seed batch and are descriptive.
Cross-channel co-change is not directional or causal.
falsifier: No geometry or channel-relation pattern is stable across seeds; report heterogeneity and do not nominate a mechanism.
